issues.title: Configure Vercel for Vite framework with SPA routing
issues.body:
Adds Vercel deployment configuration for proper Vite framework detection and SPA routing support.

## Changes

- **vercel.json**: Added `rewrites` rule to route all requests to `/index.html` for client-side routing, formatted JSON for readability
- **.vercelignore**: Created to exclude `node_modules`, `.git`, logs, and local env files from deployments

## Configuration

```json
{
  "framework": "vite",
  "rewrites": [
    {
      "source": "/(.*)",
      "destination": "/index.html"
    }
  ]
}
```

The rewrite ensures navigation to `/about`, `/dashboard`, etc. serves the SPA shell rather than 404ing. Vercel will now correctly detect Vite and enable analytics support.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> GitHub Tasks to Fix Your echo-forge Project
> 1. Add/Update vercel.json in your repo root
> Create or modify vercel.json with:
> {
>   "buildCommand": "npm run build",
>   "outputDirectory": "dist",
>   "devCommand": "npm run dev",
>   "installCommand": "npm install",
>   "framework": "vite",
>   "rewrites": [
>     {
>       "source": "/(.*)",
>       "destination": "/index.html"
>     }
>   ]
> }
> 2. Verify your package.json has correct scripts
> Make sure you have:
> {
>   "scripts": {
>     "dev": "vite",
>     "build": "vite build",
>     "preview": "vite preview"
>   }
> }
> 3. (Optional) Add .vercelignore
> To keep deployments clean:
> node_modules
> .git
> *.log
> .DS_Store
> .env.local
> 4. Commit and Push
> git add vercel.json
> git commit -m "fix: configure Vercel for Vite framework"
> git push origin main
> Vercel will automatically:
> Detect the new configuration
> Redeploy with correct framework settings
> Enable proper analytics
> 5. Enable Analytics (After Deploy)
> Go to Vercel dashboard → Your project → Analytics tab → Enable Web Analytics


</details>



<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT TIPS -->
---
